bench.unit: line group held out whole: CD4T, HCT116, HEK293T, HepG2, K562, RPE1, iPSC (all studies, states, donors, clones)
bench.truth: raw ln fold change and SE of each held-out table (pseudobulk estimators of the universes; HepG2 rebuilt here with min_expected 1)
bench.evaluated_rows: held-out table rows with >= 10 cells; in C with transfer support from >= 1 training group after QC
bench.role: development: every group has had outcome readings before (reserve_manifest.json); no result here is a confirmation

metrics.revision_before_real_data: draft v1 (17:25) had pds as primary; the synthetic positive control (test_p3_synthetic.py, beta 0.8) showed pds saturated and blind to a planted per-gene context gain (m1 - tm0: pds +0.0003, cos +0.125, mse_ratio -0.25) while transfer already discriminated; primary set to cos, pds kept as a no-regression guard, between 17:25 and the commit e60767c at 17:32:23 CEST, before any real-data fit

aggregation.group: mean over the group's evaluated rows of the per-target paired difference (rows where both arms are finite)
aggregation.macro: unweighted mean over the evaluated groups
aggregation.uncertainty: bootstrap over groups (10000 draws, seed 20261002) and per-group bootstrap over targets (2000 draws): descriptive; the group is the unit of inference

rule_C_context.c1: macro delta_ctx(cos) = macro(candidate - twin) > 0 and > max over the 5 permutation-null fits of macro(null_r - twin)
rule_C_context.c2: delta_ctx(cos) > 0 in at least 6 of 7 groups (ceil(6/7 n) if fewer groups are evaluable)
rule_C_context.c3: macro delta_swap(cos) = macro(candidate - swapped) > 0 and > 0 in at least 5 of 7 groups
rule_C_context.c4: for each secondary metric, macro(candidate - twin), oriented so that positive is better, >= the worst (minimum) macro(null_r - twin) of the same metric
rule_C_context.pass: c1 and c2 and c3 and c4
rule_C_context.threshold_motivation: no number is invented: c1 and c4 compare with fits that use the same rows and descriptors but a wrong line-to-controls association (cyclic shifts of the training groups), so they measure what an informative-looking but wrong context does on this bench; c2 and c3 count lines, the unit of inference (6 of 7 positive has one-sided sign-test p = 0.0625, 7 of 7 p = 0.0078)
rule_C_context.multiplicity: two C candidates, each with its own nulls; no correction applied; a pass of one is reported with the other's outcome

rule_C_chain.h1: macro(arm - transfer)(cos) > 0 and > 0 in at least 6 of 7 groups
rule_C_chain.h2: no macro regression against transfer on any secondary metric (oriented difference >= 0)
rule_C_chain.reading: a chain improvement by a context-free arm (tm0, m2_0) is calibration, not learned context; a chain improvement by m1/m2 counts as context only if rule_C_context also passes

rule_J.reference: embed (memoryless linear embedding: target gene loading on the training response basis)
rule_J.reference_viability: macro(embed - generic)(pds) > 0: a memoryless reference must discriminate new targets
rule_J.context: same c1-c4 with jm1 against jm1_0, jm1_swap and jm1_null1..5
rule_J.protection: a C-adopted correction is applied to J targets only if jm1 passes the J context rule; otherwise J targets keep the memoryless fallback, and the J branch of any pipeline must not score below embed (macro pds)
rule_J.approximation_declared: the gene basis V of the J reference is computed once per outer split (training groups and folds only); inner refits change only the ridge map, so training rows see their own key's responses in the basis only

rule_T: diagnostic only: never promotes a model for new contexts

outcomes.context_benefit: rule_C_context passes for >= 1 candidate: next P5 confirmation on an appropriate reserve and six-member check; no adoption from this bench
outcomes.chain_improvement_without_context: no context pass; some arm passes rule_C_chain: production candidate as calibration, judged by six members and P5
outcomes.inconclusive: a candidate fails rule_C_context only on c2 with exactly 5 of 7 positive groups, or only on c4
outcomes.no_benefit: otherwise: transfer stays; the decision names what is excluded and the next justified contrast

six_member_bench_HepG2.role: development only (HepG2 read many times before): measures the six official members for the C arms, no adoption
six_member_bench_HepG2.targets: HepG2 cube keys with >= 50 cells, stable hash order (salt six-member), first 300
six_member_bench_HepG2.truth_and_anchors: vcc2026.bench.Bench: half A of each target's cells + 4,976 controls; replicate = half B; baseline = the scorer's generic profile; local scale (u - b) / (r - b), not a VCC score
six_member_bench_HepG2.generator: trial-01 (vcc2026.inference.trial01_cells, Poisson), the generator of t22/t25, bit-identical to stage 45 (tests/test_bench_generator.py and export_parity.json)
six_member_bench_HepG2.effects: ln fold change of each arm on the cube genes mapped to HepG2 genes; other genes unobserved (kept at basal); no cis head in any arm (common to all, invisible on HepG2 in banco_hepg2_v2)
six_member_bench_HepG2.reading: per member and mean of six (MSE included, clipped as the scorer clips), paired bootstrap over targets: descriptive
